pages.text: Draws and injects fluids. Holds $(l)1000 mB$().$(br2)Point at a fluid source or a fluid handler to draw; point at an item or a tank to inject.

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Filling$() recipes (item + fluid -> item)$(li)Exclusive infusion gun recipes$(br2)$(italic)Exclusive recipes must declare at least one fluid ingredient, otherwise they fail to load.$()

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)The fluid layer is rendered by the item itself, so it shows up in logistics grids too.$(li)Placing fluid respects $(c)mayInteract$() and the fluid placement event — protection plugins still work.$(li)Use a filter to control which outputs are accepted.
